subject: PO Lexicon: tiered cap confirmation & split-line correction for Helios onboarding
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jpark@helios.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Helios AI Contracts <contracts@helios.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helios onboarding — PO guidance and initial line items

Hi Irene / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding form (helios_onboard_form_v2.pdf) and an initial spreadsheet with the line items we expect to consume (proposed_po_lines.xlsx). Two quick asks:

1) We weren't sure which "PO lexicon" Redwood expects for the vendor portal — you rely on a single PO number, or do you support multiple PO lines under one purchase reference? Our initial sheet bundles three SKUs under a single line which may conflict with your ledger rules.

2) We need a short-lived PO or provisional identifier to complete our billing portal setup while the contract routing finishes. Estimated first-month spend is ~$22k and monthly thereafter ~9–12k.

We attached the proposed lines but can split them if that helps. Also looping in Contracts (cc) in case any wording needs to change on our side.

Thanks — Jenna
Jenna Park
Procurement Lead, Helios AI
attachments: helios_onboard_form_v2.pdf, proposed_po_lines.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jpark@helios.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios onboarding — PO guidance and initial line items

Hi Jenna — welcome!

Quick answers up front: Redwood prefers a single purchase reference (PO) per vendor onboarding flow but we require discrete line items for SKU-level tracking and spend caps. If you bundle multiple SKUs into one line we'll lose the ability to gate spend by SKU. Can you split the three bundled SKUs into separate line rows and add the following columns: ledger account, cost center, and whether the line is recurring or one-time? I attached our PO template (po_template_fill.pdf) to make it easier.

On the provisional PO: procurement can issue a temporary/provisional PO for portal activation up to $30,000 while Contracts completes the DocuSign flow. We usually stamp provisional POs with a PROV prefix and expire them automatically when the fully executed PO is generated. If you confirm the revised line split and monthly run-rate we'll initiate the provisional issuance.

Next steps for Helios:
- Split bundled line into separate SKUs (add ledger + cost center columns).
- Confirm expected monthly run-rate per line (helps set per-line caps).
- Let us know if any items are vendor-managed subscriptions vs usage-based.

Thanks,
Irene
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jpark@helios.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Helios AI Contracts <contracts@helios.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helios onboarding — PO guidance and initial line items

Irene — thanks, attached is an updated sheet (proposed_po_lines.xlsx v2) where we split the three bundled SKUs into lines A1, A2, A3 and added the monthly estimates. Highlights:
- Line A1 (Core API seats): $8,000/mo recurring
- Line A2 (KV cache capacity): $7,000 one-time onboarding + $1,500/mo support
- Line A3 (Data ingress credits): $6,000/mo variable (estimate 6–9k)

Total initial month estimate: $22,500. Recurring baseline: ~$15,500/mo. We've left ledger and cost center blank — please populate the codes you want us to reference.

We also pasted a signed PO template excerpt into the sheet for your reference. Can you issue the provisional PO ID so we can finish vendor portal steps? Contracts says they should have the DocuSign ready by EOD Friday.

Thanks, Jenna
attachments: proposed_po_lines.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jpark@helios.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Helios onboarding — PO guidance and initial line items

> Irene — thanks, attached is an updated sheet (proposed_po_lines.xlsx v2) where we split the three bundled SKUs into lines A1, A2, A3 and added the monthly estimates.

Thanks Jenna — helpful breakdown. Finance can authorize a provisional PO up to $30,000 for portal activation. To finalize ledger mapping we need Markus to confirm the following mappings so Jenna can re-upload with codes:
- Core API seats -> GL 5402 / Cost center PROD-ENG
- KV cache capacity -> GL 5480 / Cost center INFRA-OPS
- Data ingress credits -> GL 5651 / Cost center DATA-SVC

Markus — can you confirm or suggest alternates? Also Rishi, please confirm whether the Data ingress line should be set as variable and capped at a monthly soft-limit of $9,000. If all good, I will issue provisional PO: PO-PROV-20271004-87 and email the vendor the reference and provisional cap rules.

Monica
Finance — Vendor Onboarding

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jpark@helios.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Helios AI Contracts <contracts@helios.ai>
Date: 2027-10-06T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: provisional PO issued / next steps (Helios onboarding)

Jenna — good to go. Per internal confirmation the ledger mappings Monica suggested are approved and Rishi agrees to a soft monthly cap of $9,000 on Data ingress credits. We have issued a provisional PO as follows:

Provisional PO: PO-PROV-20271004-87
Effective: 2027-10-06
Temporary cap: $30,000 total; per-line soft caps: A1 $8,000/mo, A2 $9,000 (initial one-time + $1,500/mo), A3 $9,000/mo soft cap
Expires: auto-revoke upon fully executed PO or 2027-11-06 (whichever comes first)

Attachments: provisional PO cover note (provisional_po_cover.pdf stub). Please attach that provisional number to your vendor portal and reference it on any initial invoices. Contracts — please proceed with DocuSign; once we have the fully executed PO we will replace PO-PROV-20271004-87 with the permanent purchase reference and update the portal.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Action items:
- Jenna: attach provisional PO reference in vendor portal and re-upload final spreadsheet with ledger codes (we filled GL and cost centers in the shared sheet).
- Contracts: confirm DocuSign envelope id when sent (link: https://app.docusign.com/helios/contract/ABC123).
- Monica: flag finance to accept first invoice against PO-PROV-20271004-87.

Irene Choi
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: provisional_po_cover.pdf
